tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Project thumbnails, case-study note boxes, chips. One step up from paper.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Second thumbnail colour so neighbouring cards differ.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Mock UI windows and anything that floats above a surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on paper, surface and card.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, dates, labels. Passes 4.5:1 on paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and chip borders. Never for text.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The signature. Name dot, big italic accents (24px+), thumbnail fills, the clock dot. Not for small text on paper (3.7:1).

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Red at small sizes: links, small labels, button fills with white text (5.1:1+).

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the lead skill chip and highlights. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Dark thumbnail ground and the dark-mode feel. Card or paper-coloured content on it.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on red-deep fills.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small UI (mock windows, chips).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card title to thumbnail; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between work cards side by side.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of work; between about columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags inside mock UIs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Mock UI windows, note boxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Project thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Skill chips, badges, pill buttons.
